finding: Runner-sync receipt publication can deadlock with protected evidence hooks: the receipt is required for provenance, but committing the receipt is blocked as protected evidence missing task context, forcing emergency path-bounded no-verify commits.
expectedBehavior: Framework-temp runner-sync receipts should carry enough task/session context for normal governed commit hooks, or runner-sync should provide a dedicated publication command that commits the receipt and runner bundle atomically.
evidenceOrRepro: During ATM-GOV-0245, runner publication commits `1cabac72e0c24bb8c7ea3820f7832c1de88d0b4d` and `fa64ef7ba2c7b1b669055b7dbbc5d73390e5c824` required emergency path-bounded commits and later forward attestations because normal hooks rejected runner-sync receipt evidence context.
followUp: Closed 2026-09-03: runner-sync receipts publish atomically at one governed evidence path with a durable task/steward/receipt continuation command and no manual-review residue. Framework-temp publication capability authorizes only the bound receipt and its owned outputs for a normal governed commit, while rejecting foreign inventory. `tests/cli/runner-sync-post-close-receipt-publication.test.ts` and `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/__tests__/framework-temp-publication-capability.test.ts` pass; the frozen runner source seal is valid with `syncRequired=false`.
